Instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (ms pages 0-9, footer X_086_31/6/2 on every page, this set only): a bare OR in Q22, 24, 28, 34, 35, 36 and inside Q37(III), Q38(III), Q39(III) = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off the scheme image; each re-derived and agrees. No void notes anywhere in the scheme. Decimal points: the paper prints none in a stem; the scheme uses raised dots (0·22 A, 0·05%). Q36's first branch carries no printed (a) label for the whole: it is printed as parts (a)(b), then OR, then parts (a)(b); filed as Q36a / Q36b as on 31/6/1 Q35. Case studies print (I), (II), (III)(a) OR (III)(b); refs follow the 31/6/1 precedent (Q37i, Q37ii, Q37iiia, Q37iiib).
